name: the render tail never inserts the section
why: The section exists only through the hook in startFetchingProcess()'s render tail. Without it nothing appears after "Show all".

name: the section is not opened after makeH2sCollapsible()
why: makeH2sCollapsible() starts every h2 collapsed except the tracklist's; the decision is that this one starts open. A section that merely exists is invisible.

name: the section lands below the tracklist instead of above it
why: Placement is a decision (above "Tracklist"); the spec asserts sec.nextElementSibling === h2.tracklist.

name: the h2 count keeps the tab text instead of the record
why: The tab count (13 on this fixture) is provisional; once the record arrives the h2 must say how many images were actually shown (16).

name: the star reads the Front type instead of the main-front flag
why: An image can be typed Front without being the archive's main front. The spec's record makes image 2 Back/Front with front:false.

name: a "Cover art (0)" tab still builds the section and fetches
why: The tab count is free; a release that says 0 must cost no request.
grep: gets no section and makes no request

name: 404 is reported as a failure
why: A 404 is a fact about the release (no artwork), not a bad minute at the archive; offering a retry for it is wrong.

name: the retry forgets to drop the session zero
why: Tier 1 would serve the cached zero straight back and no request would be made (docs/claude/artwork-caa-eaa.md, CAA/EAA retry).

name: the setting gate is gone
why: Turning sa_enable_release_tracks_cover_art off must remove the section and its request entirely.
